earnRows.name: Intermiles (Etihad)
earnRows.cap: A maximum of 25,000 InterMiles can be earned on your spends per anniversary year.|When this cap is reached, a InterMiles Uncapping Fee of ₹7,500 will be levied to your Credit Card account.|To continue earning InterMiles, please make this fee payment.|Please call our Customer Care to reverse the fee if you choose not to pay it; further InterMiles will not accrue in that anniversary cycle.|The cap will be reset with the start of the next anniversary year and InterMiles will flow to your InterMiles account automatically from the next statement cycle.|An anniversary year is one year from the date of your card setup.
